products.title: Home Run Derby: Baseball Chokes From Everywhere by Magid Hage
products.body:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belt Magid Hage compiles his years of experience with trial and error to bring you the technique for a perfect baseball choke

  • Learn all the angles and grips necessary to make this unorthodox choke successful.
  • Focus deeply on setups from the bottom and stop yourself from getting smashed by your opponent.
  • Hone in on the proper finishing mechanics and make this one of the most used attacks in your arsenal.

Black Belt Competitor & Innovator Magid Hage Shows You His Blueprint For His Signature Baseball Bat Choke That He Uses To Put People To Sleep From Everywhere

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

Being able to successfully attack from the bottom especially as a smaller opponent is extremely important. Finding good grips and getting to a place where you can begin to attack to the point where you leave your opponent no choice but to defend should be exactly what you are aiming for. While training in the gi and attacking from the bottom, collar chokes are a super-effective option. In this series, Magid Hage covers everything you need to know when it comes to successfully utilizing the baseball choke from absolutely every position.

Start by taking an in-depth look at the proper grips and setup mechanics. Success with this attack is very much attributed to creating the popper angles and leverage. Magid shows just that as he demonstrates the proper ways to make these grips as controlling as possible. Take into account all of the details of this attack and check out some slick ways to use it from over under, a leg drag, and reverse half.

Understand the concept of expanding and how the creation of space greatly improves your ability to finish the choke. See how Magid utilizes the knee shield to both prevent the guard pass while also setting up the choke simultaneously. Work on finishing mechanics that are used at the highest of levels, and make sure this is a submission you are confident you can hit no matter where you are in a match.  

Magid Hage is a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belt who has been training for the majority of his life. He began training with his father who is also a black belt and had the opportunity to pick up tips from numerous high-level practitioners from a young age. As you watch Magid flow through these techniques and listen to his comprehensive explanations, you will be amazed at how deep his passion and understanding for this art is. Begin incorporating the baseball choke into your attacking sequences and make sure you finish it every time by using the high-level techniques in this instructional!
